objective: Review the first real direct-launch handoff run boundary and decide whether a scoped run gate may attempt the native parser metadata to sidecar launcher authority chain.

review_decision.reason: The definition is narrow enough for a first run attempt after review. It requires the reviewed handoff fixture surface, exact pulp_ita_mha 64x1 scope, the existing sidecar launcher entrypoint, explicit generated-output boundaries, and coverage-output equivalence over the existing 29-word output contract.
review_decision.weakest_point: This is still only boundary review. It permits a future run gate to attempt the authority chain, but it does not execute the sidecar launcher, record native-path coverage-output compare, or measure timing.
accepted_because: the eligible input is limited to native_verilator_parser_direct_command_path_direct_launch_handoff_fixture with direct_launch_handoff_metadata_ready_for_review status
the future run remains scoped to pulp_ita_mha, config/slice_launch_templates/pulp_ita_mha.json, and 64x1
success requires sidecar launch and coverage-output compare to be reached from the native path
the compare target is the existing coverage_output_equivalence 29-word contract, not raw full-state equality
direct_launch_handoff_failure, sidecar_stage_failure, and compare_failure remain distinct
reports and artifacts remain generated evidence and are not source of truth

required_next_gate.name: run_verilator_native_option_parser_direct_command_path_native_invocation_direct_launch_handoff_gate
must_record: whether a Verilator-facing parse result and reviewed handoff metadata entered the sidecar launcher
whether coverage-output compare was reached from the native path
which failure class was observed if the chain stops
all generated reports and artifacts as noncanonical evidence

non_claims: reports and artifacts are generated evidence, not source of truth
